batter-total-bases.definition: Bases earned through hits: single=1, double=2, triple=3, home run=4. Walks and stolen bases do not contribute.
batter-total-bases.participationRule: Uses the verified general MLB batter Pick'em rule bundle: the batter must appear in the official starting lineup for a full-game batter projection to grade.
batter-total-bases.tieRule: A selection tying its posted projection is void under the verified general Pick'em tie rule.

pitcher-strikeouts.definition: Counts strikeouts officially recorded as the pitcher; batter strikeouts do not contribute.
pitcher-strikeouts.participationRule: For a full-game pitching projection, the player must throw a pitch in the game; starting only as a hitter without pitching voids the pitching projection.
pitcher-strikeouts.tieRule: A selection tying its posted projection is void under the verified general Pick'em tie rule.

pitcher-outs.definition: Counts outs recorded while the pitcher is pitching in the game.
pitcher-outs.participationRule: For a full-game pitching projection, the player must throw a pitch in the game; starting only as a hitter without pitching voids the pitching projection.
pitcher-outs.tieRule: A selection tying its posted projection is void under the verified general Pick'em tie rule.

pitcher-walks-allowed.definition: Counts walks (BB) officially recorded against the pitcher. Hit by pitch does not count toward the total.
pitcher-walks-allowed.participationRule: For a full-game pitching projection, the player must throw a pitch in the game; starting only as a hitter without pitching voids the pitching projection.
pitcher-walks-allowed.tieRule: A selection tying its posted projection is void under the verified general Pick'em tie rule.
